trials.claim: Tier 1 includes lifetime access and future Prime Chef Plan updates
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to GoBrunch
- All future Prime Chef Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The reviews only report little change and a stale roadmap over several months; they do not directly show that lifetime access or future Prime Chef Plan updates were denied, and no defense exhibit confirms the promise.

exhibits.quote: Unfortunately, six months later, they're still selling the product on AppSumo, yet NOTHING seems to have changed.
exhibits.argument: No changes after six months undermines promise of future Prime Chef Plan updates.

exhibits.quote: Their public roadmap seems that it hasn't been updated for months, which doesn't inspire much confidence.
exhibits.argument: Stale roadmap undermines claim of ongoing future updates.

trials.claim: Buyers can host unlimited webinars with no installation required for organizers or attendees
trials.claimQuote: You’ll be able to host unlimited webinars inside of GoBrunch—no installation required for you or your attendees!
trials.reasoning: The vendor supports webinars and states no installations or downloads are required, using browser access. The 600-person per-room cap limits room size, not the number of webinars, and the vague 'not fit for purpose' review does not materially undercut this.

exhibits.quote: The maximum number of people in our highest plan is 600 per room.
I purchased it to do webinars and it is not fit for purpose.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports product is not fit for webinars despite unlimited webinars claim.

exhibits.quote: GoBrunch is a perfect fit for building spaces for communities and virtual offices. Inside of it, you can have a wide range of options, such as meetings, webinars, events, workshops, showcases with live and on-demand content, making it a hub for all your interactive needs.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the platform supports meetings and webinars as part of its interactive options.

exhibits.quote: Nope! No installations, no hassle. GoBrunch is all about convenience. Just fire up your web browser, head to GoBrunch.com, and dive into the virtual world without any downloads or or either sign-ups for your members.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms no installation is required and access is via web browser without downloads.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers can upgrade their license to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased GoBrunch can upgrade their license to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence either way about previous customers upgrading to increase feature limits.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence either way about previous customers being grandfathered into new feature limits.

trials.claim: Users can set up a virtual classroom in minutes with screen share with sound, camera, and presenter broadcast
trials.claimQuote: It only takes a few minutes to set up your virtual classroom with the immediate ability to screen share with sound, enable your camera, and broadcast presenters.
trials.reasoning: The vendor pricing page lists 'Broadcast Video and Audio to All Rooms' as under maintenance, which directly conflicts with the claimed immediate ability to broadcast presenters, despite one review reporting quick basic setup.

exhibits.quote: Broadcast Video and Audio to All Rooms [under maintenance]
exhibits.argument: Broadcast feature listed as under maintenance contradicts immediate broadcast ability.

exhibits.quote: It’s not intuitive. You can’t see what you’re recording and the room setup is labor intensive.
exhibits.argument: Labor-intensive setup contradicts setup in minutes claim.

exhibits.quote: Easy to set up. It took perhaps 5 minutes for a basic orientation, and I'm ready for my first meeting on this platform.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms setup takes about five minutes before being ready for a meeting.

exhibits.quote: Broadcast Video and Audio to All Rooms [under maintenance]
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists broadcast of video and audio to all rooms as a platform feature.

trials.claim: Users can play video content, present uploaded slides, record sessions, and download video files
trials.claimQuote: Once the session is live, you’ll be able to play video content, present uploaded slides, record your sessions, and download video files.
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms sharing pre-recorded videos in rooms and saving session recordings in the cloud. The reviews complain about recording sync and captured pop-ups, which are quality issues and do not show the video or recording features are absent.

exhibits.quote: the audio being out of sync when recordings are made.
exhibits.argument: Out-of-sync recordings undermine reliable record and download claim.

exhibits.quote: Here everything you have on your screen is recorded, with the pop-up to stop sharing...
exhibits.argument: Recording captures everything including pop-ups undermines professional recording claim.

exhibits.quote: Share pre-recorded videos within virtual rooms for asynchronous watching.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms users can play video content inside virtual rooms.

exhibits.quote: Easily save your recordings in the cloud. Share those epic moments with a single click.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms sessions can be recorded and saved in the cloud.
